name: Spain
description:
A vibrant Mediterranean country known for its passion for life, world-class art and architecture, beautiful beaches, and delicious cuisine. Spain offers a balanced lifestyle across diverse regions.

## Key Highlights
- World-class art, architecture, and cultural heritage
- Beautiful Mediterranean beaches and coastal living
- Vibrant food culture and social lifestyle
longdescription: Spain is a Mediterranean country renowned for its passionate culture, world-class art and architecture, and vibrant social lifestyle. Located on the Iberian Peninsula, Spain spans from Mediterranean beaches to mountain regions and interior plateaus. Madrid and Barcelona are major cities with distinct characters: Madrid is the capital and cultural center with world-class museums, while Barcelona combines modernist architecture with Mediterranean beach culture. Spain's art heritage includes works by Goya, Velázquez, Picasso, and Dalí, housed in museums like the Prado. The country is famous for its cuisine, wine, and food culture, with Spanish gastronomy respected globally. Spain offers an excellent climate, affordable lifestyle compared to Northern Europe, and diverse landscapes. The Spanish emphasize work-life balance, with long lunch breaks and evening social time being cultural norms. Healthcare is excellent and publicly provided. Spanish is the official language, widely spoken throughout the country. Spain has experienced economic challenges but continues to attract expats, remote workers, and retirees seeking Mediterranean living. Tourism is a major industry, and many regions depend heavily on seasonal visitors. The country offers opportunities in technology, tourism, education, and creative industries, particularly in Barcelona's tech scene and Madrid's business environment. Spain combines Mediterranean climate, affordable living, excellent healthcare, rich culture, and vibrant social life, making it attractive for those seeking European living with relaxed Mediterranean character.

visas.name: Spain Work Visa for Skilled Professionals
visas.description: Spain's work visa for non-EU skilled professionals who have a job offer from a Spanish employer in a qualified occupation, granting residence and work rights in Spain.

visas.name: Spain Working Holiday Visa
visas.description: Spain's Working Holiday Visa for young citizens of partner countries to live and work in Spain for up to 12 months, combining travel with temporary employment or work experience.

visas.name: Spain Job Seeker Visa
visas.description: Spain's job seeker visa allows non-EU qualified professionals and graduates to enter Spain for up to 12 months to search for employment or to set up a business.
benefits: Search for work in Spain on the ground
Convert to work permit if employed

visas.name: Spain Family Reunification Visa
visas.description: Spain's family reunification visa allows non-EU residents with a valid long-term residence permit to bring close family members (spouse, minor children, dependent parents) to live with them in Spain.

visas.name: Spain Student Visa
visas.description: Spain's long-term student visa for non-EU nationals enrolled in a Spanish university, language school, or accredited course for stays exceeding 90 days.

visas.name: Spain Entrepreneur Visa
visas.description: Spain's Entrepreneur Visa under the Entrepreneurs' Law for non-EU nationals who wish to develop an innovative business activity with special economic interest to Spain.
benefits: Run an innovative business in Spain

visas.name: Spain Self-Employed Visa
visas.description: Spain's self-employed or autonomous worker visa (cuenta propia) for non-EU professionals who wish to work as independent freelancers or establish and run their own business in Spain.

visas.name: Spain Standard Work Visa
visas.description: Spain's standard work visa (Visado de Trabajo por Cuenta Ajena) for non-EU nationals who have a job offer from a Spanish employer and employer-sponsored work permit authorisation.
benefits: Live and work legally in Spain

visas.name: Spain Digital Nomad Visa
visas.description: Spain's new Digital Nomad Visa allows remote workers to live in Spain while working for foreign companies. Includes tax benefits and path to residency.

visas.name: Spain Non-Lucrative Visa
visas.description: Spain's Non-Lucrative Visa is ideal for retirees and those with passive income who want to enjoy Spanish culture without working.

Citizenship by Descent.desc: Children of Spanish citizens acquire citizenship automatically at birth. Ancestry rights available for descendants of Spanish exiles.

Naturalization.desc:
**Requirements:** 10 years legal residence (5 years for refugees, 2 years for nationals of Latin American, Portuguese-speaking, Andorra, Philippines, Equatorial Guinea countries), Spanish language, cultural integration.

**Processing:** Ministry of Inclusion, Seguridad Social y Migraciones, 12-24 months.

Spouse Naturalization.desc: Spouses may apply after 1 year marriage. If spouse is Spanish, residence requirement reduced to 1 year.

Special Recognition.desc: Historical descendants of Spanish exiles and persons of Spanish origin may claim citizenship through simplified process.

tax_advice:
- Spain uses progressive income tax (19% to 45%)
- Corporate tax rate is 25% (reduced rates for startups)
- VAT at 21% (reduced rates of 10%, 4%, and 0%)
- Expat tax relief (Beckham Law) offers 6-year tax break for certain income types
- Non-residents taxed at flat 19% on Spanish-sourced income
- Capital gains: 19% to 23% depending on holding period
- Wealth tax abolished in 2008, replaced with increased VAT
- Regional variations exist (Canary Islands, Balearic Islands offer incentives)
local_tips:
- Spanish essential; regional languages (Catalan, Basque) matter in some regions
- Bureaucracy less efficient than Germany but improving; patience required
- Healthcare excellent and affordable; register with local centro de salud
- Visa sponsorship needed for work; digital nomad visa available
- Siesta culture stronger south; adjust business schedule accordingly
- Labor market competitive; network heavily before moving
- Quality of life exceptionally high; integration easier than expected
